Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ A man, maybe 20s catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A man, maybe 20s eats quiet by the fire, scraping the bowl clean with their thumb.
📨 Word came: Nadia Khoury wants to join Haven. "I can work. That's all I'm selling." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📓 Journal: Nadia Khoury applied remotely.

"Hey." A person, maybe 30s, with freckles settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 30s, with freckles.)

— Open ground —
Grasses head-high. Good greens, good visibility, nowhere to hide.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 12 people, 3 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — Yuki telling A man, maybe 50s about Fatima. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands telling Yuki about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
Journal: Disturbed ground grows good weeds.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.

A runner from Emberhold, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

Fresh-cut stems on the northeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (Thornfield's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

— An old trail —
Where the trail crosses bare rock, someone scratched a mark — an arrow, or a tally, or a prayer. Pre-Burn. You add nothing. You remember it.
Something moves out there — the humming in the grass.
Movement — an armadillo rooting in the leaf litter, armor clanking.
👁 It doesn't run — the armor IS the plan. It'll hunch down and dare you. The armor turns a blow; grab the soft underbelly, or trap the grub trail at night.
You see smoke on the horizon. Ashford — 11 people, 4 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Journal: Trampled ground. The humble weeds win.
